name: better-prompt
description: Shows context, 5h and 7d usage with an animated pixel crab, one crab per subagent, and counts topics and divergence.

model.title: Topic model
model.description: Model that classifies each prompt to count topics and divergence (a cheap one is enough).

gaugeWarnPercent.title: Gauge threshold %
gaugeWarnPercent.description: Where the context gauge marks its limit (10-95). Only colours the gauge.

divergeWarnPercent.title: Divergence threshold %
divergeWarnPercent.description: Where the divergence meter turns amber/red (10-95).

keepWarm.title: Keep cache warm
keepWarm.description: While the session is idle, send a tiny background request every few minutes so the prompt cache never lapses. Each ping re-reads the whole conversation from cache (cheap per token, but it counts toward your limits) and it runs for as long as the session stays open.

keepWarmMinutes.title: Keep-warm interval (minutes)
keepWarmMinutes.description: Minutes between pings (1-4; the cache lapses after 5).
